1  AND SESSIONS JUDGE, BAGALKOT TO SIT AT JAMAKHANDI AND  MEMBER, MOTOR ACCIDENT CLAIMS TRIBUNAL, NO.XI,
 JAMKHANDI, AT: JAMKHANDI IN M.V.C. NO.208/2012 DATED  03.09.2015, IN THE INTEREST OF JUSTICE AND EQUITY.
THIS APPEAL COMING ON FOR ADMISSION THIS DAY

,
 JUDGMENT WAS DELIVERED THEREIN AS UNDER:
 -2-  NC: 2025:KHC-D:15194  MFA No. 103884 of 2016 HC-KAR CORAM: THE HON'BLE DR. JUSTICE CHILLAKUR SUMALATHA  ORAL JUDGMENT (PER: THE HON'BLE DR. JUSTICE CHILLAKUR SUMALATHA) Challenge in this appeal is the award that is passed by the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal-XI, Jamakhandi in MVC 208 of 2012 dated 03.09.2015.
2.
Sri M.C.Hukkeri, learned counsel for the appellant submits that, the appellant is the owner of the offending vehicle which is involved in the accident.
Though the appeal is filed challenging the quantum of amount that is awarded as compensation, now the appellant intends to satisfy the award and therefore necessary orders may be passed.

3. Having considered the submission that is made by learned counsel for the appellant that the appellant now intends to satisfy the award without any dispute regarding the contents of the order passed, this Court considers desirable to dismiss the appeal.
NC: 2025:KHC-D:15194 HC-KAR 4.
5. Amount if any in deposit, be transmitted to the concerned tribunal immediately.
